description: The bar chart compares the task count performance of two multilingual BERT models, mBERT and XLM-RoBERTa, across various language families. The horizontal axis lists the language families, including IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the task count, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40. Each language family has three bars representing the task count for mBERT (light blue), XLM-RoBERTa (dark blue), and the same (green). The mBERT model generally shows higher task counts than XLM-RoBERTa in most language families, with the highest task count observed in the IE-Slavic family. The XLM-RoBERTa model outperforms mBERT in the IE-Germanic and IE-Indic language families. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on the bars.
